findings.title: ls alias crashes in non-interactive shells
findings.root_cause: The colorls alias needs a terminal size.
findings.fix: Alias ls only in interactive shells.

findings.title: guarded-delete hook rejects git branch inside command substitution
findings.root_cause: Agents wrap git branch cleanup or rm -rf in substitutions or on non-cache paths, which the guarded-delete hook cannot verify, so each attempt is blocked and rephrased.
findings.fix: Document in the factory loop that branch deletes take literal names and worktree cleanup goes through factory.py, so agents stop composing blocked forms.
